name: Apiary
text: Holds up to three bees from jars and turns the flowers within five blocks into combs, one comb per bee every three minutes, by day and out of the rain. Empty hand takes the combs; sneak to take the bees out in jars. Age I.

name: Bee Jar
text: Use on a bee to catch it, on the ground to let it out. Carries its species. Age I.

name: Sandy Comb
text: Made by Sandy bees (wild). Craft it to crush it. Age 1.

name: Muddy Comb
text: Made by Muddy bees (wild). Craft it to crush it. Age 1.

name: Coal Comb
text: Made by Coal bees, bred from a meadow and a sandy bee. Smelt it for the resource. Age 2.

name: Iron Comb
text: Made by Iron bees, bred from a coal and a muddy bee. Smelt it for the resource. Age 3.

name: Copper Comb
text: Made by Copper bees, bred from a sandy and a muddy bee. Smelt it for the resource. Age 3.

name: Redstone Comb
text: Made by Redstone bees, bred from a coal and a copper bee. Craft it to crush it. Age 4.

name: Gold Comb
text: Made by Gold bees, bred from a iron and a copper bee. Smelt it for the resource. Age 4.

name: Lapis Comb
text: Made by Lapis bees, bred from a iron and a redstone bee. Craft it to crush it. Age 4.

name: Quartz Comb
text: Made by Quartz bees, bred from a sandy and a redstone bee. Smelt it for the resource. Age 5.

name: Glowstone Comb
text: Made by Glowstone bees, bred from a gold and a redstone bee. Craft it to crush it. Age 5.

name: Diamond Comb
text: Made by Diamond bees, bred from a gold and a lapis bee. Smelt it for the resource. Age 7.

name: Meadow Nest
text: A wild nest in plains, sunflower plains, meadow and similar places. By day it lets out Meadow bees, up to three nearby. Age 1.

name: Sandy Nest
text: A wild nest in desert, beach, badlands and similar places. By day it lets out Sandy bees, up to three nearby. Age 1.

name: Muddy Nest
text: A wild nest in swamp, mangrove swamp, river and similar places. By day it lets out Muddy bees, up to three nearby. Age 1.
